items_flat.title_en: OpenAI drops GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by over 20%
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-5.6 Sol API 與點數定價調降逾 20%
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a promotional price reduction for GPT-5.6 Sol on the API and eligible ChatGPT Work/Codex credits: input now $4/M tokens and output $20/M tokens (roughly 20% lower input and 33% lower output). The promo runs at least through mid-to-late November; Pro/Plus/Business subscription usage is unchanged.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 API 與符合資格的 ChatGPT Work／Codex 點數上實施促銷降價：輸入 $4／百萬 tokens、輸出 $20／百萬 tokens（輸入約降 20%、輸出約降 33%）。促銷至少持續至 11 月中下旬；Pro／Plus／Business 訂閱用量維持不變。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cut strengthens Sol’s price-performance against competing frontier models and may accelerate high-volume agentic and coding workloads. Key uncertainty is whether the promotional rate becomes permanent or reverts after the stated window.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此降價強化 Sol 相對其他前沿模型的性價比，可能加速高量 agent 與編碼工作負載採用。關鍵不確定性在於促銷價是否會在期限後永久化或回調。
items_flat.quote: As we continue to push the frontier of capabilities while improving efficiency, we're dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next 3 months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著我們持續推動能力前沿並提升效率，我們將 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 API 與點數定價在接下來 3 個月調降逾 20%。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 已上架 Google Enterprise Agent Platform
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is available via Google’s Enterprise Agent Platform (Model Garden). The model retains its 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels (low/medium/high/xhigh) at $2 / $0.50 cached / $6 per million tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已可透過 Google Enterprise Agent Platform（Model Garden）使用。模型維持 50 萬 tokens 上下文與可配置推理等級（low／medium／high／xhigh），定價為每百萬 tokens 輸入 $2／快取 $0.50／輸出 $6。
items_flat.analysis_en: Adding a major cloud provider channel lowers friction for Google Cloud customers already using agent platforms and increases competitive pressure on pricing and availability of frontier models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 新增主要雲端供應商通路降低 Google Cloud 既有 agent 平台用戶的採用門檻，並對前沿模型的定價與可得性形成競爭壓力。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們很高興宣布，Grok 4.6 現已可在 Google Enterprise Agent Platform 上使用。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Bot expanded to more subscription plans
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Bot 擴大至更多訂閱方案
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI stated that Grok Bot (always-on AI teammates with their own computer) is now included with SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and all Cursor Teams plans, broadening access beyond the earlier limited rollout.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 表示 Grok Bot（具備獨立電腦的常駐 AI 隊友）現已納入 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+ 以及所有 Cursor Teams 方案，擴大原先有限的推出範圍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Wider plan inclusion signals product maturation of persistent agent teammates and may drive higher engagement inside the Cursor and SuperGrok ecosystems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣的方案涵蓋顯示常駐 agent 隊友產品趨於成熟，可能提升 Cursor 與 SuperGrok 生態系內的使用黏著度。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot is now available for SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and all Cursor Teams plans.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現已適用於 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+ 以及所有 Cursor Teams 方案。

brief_en: Quiet Sunday for frontier labs. Carryover from Friday: OpenAI’s >20% temporary GPT-5.6 Sol API/credit price cut and xAI’s Grok 4.6 expansion onto Google Enterprise Agent Platform plus broader Grok Bot plan access remain the day’s main signals.
brief_zh: 週日大廠動態平靜。延續週五重點：OpenAI 對 GPT-5.6 Sol API／點數臨時降價逾 20%，以及 xAI 將 Grok 4.6 上架 Google Enterprise Agent Platform 並擴大 Grok Bot 訂閱涵蓋範圍。
